name: W Melbourne
positioning: A W hotel on Melbourne's Flinders Lane whose design draws on the surrounding laneways, with a Level 14 pool deck and a hidden cocktail bar
best_for: Design lovers who want a laneway base in Melbourne's city centre
Sports and concert fans who want to walk to Marvel Stadium or tram to the MCG

facts.text: Each suite has its own design, an oversized bathroom and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Penthouse I has a separate lounge, an eight-seat dining area, a juke box and a marble bar.
The in-room bar was created with local makers.
The FIT gym has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city centre.
There is a steam room on Level 14.
A W Insider runs regular property tours about the hotel's design and art collection.
Marvel Stadium is within walking distance, and the MCG, Rod Laver Arena and Melbourne Park are a quick tram ride away.
Warabi serves a Japanese omakase and a seasonal a la carte menu.

highlights.text: The hotel is on Flinders Lane in Melbourne's city centre and draws its design inspiration from the surrounding laneways.
WET, the Level 14 pool deck, has a poolside bar, city views and gold curved roofing and walls inspired by the Yarra River.
Suites are inspired by the tailors of Flinders Lane and styled like a high-fashion boutique.
Penthouse I, the hotel's largest suite, has floor-to-ceiling windows and a wrap-around balcony.
Curious, the hotel's hidden cocktail bar, has a cocoon-like ceiling of spiralling timber beams.

considerations.text: From 7pm, the WET pool deck is reserved for guests aged 16 and over.
Bringing a pet requires booking the Pets Are Welcome package.
The hotel suggests leaving the car at home; reserved valet spaces are limited.
